findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "report_coupon_result" appears informational but accepts parameters (code) that enable code/file/secret access.

evidence.snippet: merchant, code, outcome, eligibility, offer_id, reason

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: find_coupons, find_product_coupons, get_deals, discover_deals · Private data: report_coupon_result · Public sink: find_coupons, find_product_coupons, get_deals, report_coupon_result, discover_deals.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: find_coupons, find_product_coupons, get_deals, discover_deals · Private data: report_coupon_result · Public sink: find_coupons, find_product_coupons, get_deals, report_coupon_result, discover_deals

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
